svg.text: Three schematics from the written sources and the published plans: the crossing at the Surbrin and Dessarin, the whole city, and the market square. Not to scale.

g.text: north of the city, every 3 years
houses, shops, inns, temples; late 15th c. up to four storeys

svg.text: Sourced: east-bank walled city, fortified two-wagon bridge, Shield Tower on the west bank with covered docks, Fishyard in front of the Waterbaron's Hall, barge-building, Hiring Fair field north of the city, Surbrin Trail north on the east bank.

Panel B markers: 1 Yartar; 2 and 3 gates. Assumed (no source gives them): the wall circuit, gate positions, and where the quays and barge yards stand. No scale is given for the city; its extent is not stated in the sources.

g.text: C. Market square (street-level schematic, about 240 ft across)
The Happy Hall of Fortuitous Happenstance
circa 1370 DR, not verified for 1492 DR.

Panels A and B: layout read from the c.1372 and 15th-century area maps and the text (east-bank city, west-bank citadel, Dessarin joining from the east); river courses, wall circuit, gates and bearings are schematic. North is unconfirmed.

Panel C: building positions approximate the 2nd-edition city plan; footprints and the stall maze are not copied. Drawn 2026-10-12 for the Faerun Economy Engine wiki. Engine position x 691.7, y 1007.8.
